items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: we bought all our music from those guys. See? But then they had no bands up there playing that music, see? See? ... Scott Johnson, Walter Jacobs and Tom Tanker

ctx.x: Well, you were saying that the clarinet's played too many notes and if you say anything, well, they say it's antique. Yeah.

They're not, it's too many notes, and that goes for some of your trumpet players too, playing, playing what they call, what is it, jazz music. See, there's no such thing as Dix-Line music, it's jazz music, that's what we play. Ragtime music, see? Because that's the first music we played, Ragtime music. Now St. Louis should have had credit for Ragtime music. They should have, because we bought all our music from St. Louis, but we paid away from them. See? New Orleans played the music. But St. Louis, well we bought…
